messages:
anya: Heads-up — noticed the new strict schema gate in canary is rejecting ~0.7% of fncall/tool responses and we're silently falling back to text responses. Console charts show a tiny spike in "rejections_count" but no sampled payloads. We need better visibility before rollouts.

deploybot: canary deploy finished for release/strict-validate-toolhook v2 at 2025-11-02T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

mira: @anya can you paste an example of a rejected payload? Is it consistently the same tool or a few customers?

anya: quick example (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "kb-search",
  "response": {
    "items": [{"id": 123, "title": null}],
    "cursor": "abcd"
  }
}
```
The validator errors on `title` being null when the schema says string non-null. It's coming from multiple regions but mostly small customers.

leo: Console/product concern: sampling raw payloads could leak PII. We need an approved redaction plan before increasing sampling. Also UX: users see a fallback but not why — we should surface a short failure reason in the route trace.

mira: Agreed on redaction. For short-term: propose soft-fail mode that returns the tool output but flags `validation_warning` metadata so UI can show a badge and we can route those traces to a restricted sampling stream.

sam: Routing/quotas angle: if we start soft-failing, we may double-count token billing if the fallback path generates text. Need to ensure billing attribution stays tied to original route_id and that quotas don't get charged twice.

cassie: From oncall POV, current alerting only fires on rejection rate >1% for all customers. 0.7% across canary isn't alerting. Suggest 2 things: a) a canary-specific rule that triggers at 0.3% with higher sensitivity, b) add an SLA impact estimator in the alert payload.

anya: +1 on canary threshold. Also we should capture a hashed sample of the offending field (e.g. title) and the validator path to speed root-cause without storing the whole payload. Hashing + policy should satisfy product/security.

mira: Implementation sketch: add `validation_mode` enum on rollout config: OFF | SOFT | STRICT. In SOFT: accept response, attach `x-validation` header with `warnings:[{path, code, fingerprint}]`, send sampled full payloads to `restricted.telemetry` for 24h retention. Dashboard exposes counts by fingerprint.

leo: UX asks: show inline badge "tool output flagged" with hover text linking to trace id and limited reason (e.g. "missing required title"). Make sure link is RBAC-protected.

sam: We also need to think about quotas: soft-fail responses that trigger fallback generators must be avoided. If the downstream fallback is only for STRICT, then fine. Otherwise patch router to prefer the tool output even when flagged.

cassie: Can we add a quick canary dashboard tile: rejections by country, by tool, and by fingerprint. Also add a heatmap for time-of-day. That will help ops decide whether to pause rollout.

mira: I'll draft the rollout PR: defaults to SOFT for 48h canary, sampling_rate=0.05 for restricted telemetry, add RBAC gating, and bump canary alert to 0.3%. Will post PR link when ready.

anya: Thanks — once PR lands, I'll run a small synthetic test hitting edge cases and confirm the UI shows the badge. :thumbsup:

leo: Also add a product-facing note in the console changelog explaining what the badge means and how customers can opt into stricter validation.

deploybot: note: PR 4123 opened by mira for strict-validate canary config (draft).

mira: PR posted: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4123 — includes schema-mode, sampling integration, and dashboard wiring. Requesting review from @sam, @leo, @anya.

sam: I'll review today and validate billing attribution on a staging run.

anya: I'll coordinate the synthetic tests and also prepare a short incident runbook in case strict mode starts spiking.

cassie: leaving a note for oncall rotation: if rejections >1% for >10m, page oncall and pause canary.

mira: Thanks team — we'll iterate.
